home.faq.title: Questions before we start?
home.faq.description: A few quick answers for teams comparing partners for software, automation or AI work.
home.faq.q1: Can you build the product from idea to launch?
home.faq.a1: Yes. We cover discovery, UX/UI, development, testing, deployment and long-term support with one integrated team.
home.faq.q2: Can you improve an existing website or app?
home.faq.a2: Yes. We can audit the current product, fix performance and UX issues, then add new features without forcing a full rebuild.
home.faq.q3: Do you work with AI automation?
home.faq.a3: Yes. We build assistants, RAG systems, workflow automations and internal AI tools grounded in your own data.
